# Header names observed on Claude Code requests when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points
# at a local listener. Recorded on POST /v1/messages?beta=true (run 2, API-key
# auth) and HEAD /api/hello (run 2); Authorization was observed on POST
# /v1/messages (run 1, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN auth). Values are never recorded.
#
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   <header name>   <yes|no>   yes = the header carries credentials
Accept	no
Accept-Encoding	no
Anthropic-Beta	no
Anthropic-Dangerous-Direct-Browser-Access	no
Anthropic-Version	no
Authorization	yes
Connection	no
Content-Length	no
Content-Type	no
User-Agent	no
X-Api-Key	yes
X-App	no
X-Claude-Code-Session-Id	no
X-Stainless-Arch	no
X-Stainless-Lang	no
X-Stainless-Os	no
X-Stainless-Package-Version	no
X-Stainless-Retry-Count	no
X-Stainless-Runtime	no
X-Stainless-Runtime-Version	no
X-Stainless-Timeout	no
